sections.text:
Work to be 
Carried Out
Clean the dirt and dust which accumulated.

Clean an insulating parts with a 
soft, dry linen cloth.
Read and record the input and output voltage.

Check lightening of bus bar 
connection.
Check the monitoring units.

Measure mains supply voltage and 
check whether all contactors are live.

Check auxiliary circuit connection 
on devices and terminal strips for tight fit.

Check with the test boot on whether all 
 lamps are in working condition

Check fuses for continuity and 
replace in case need.

Check the charger for abnormal 
noise and smell.
Place the battery charger back into normal operating condition.

Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I2, to be 
 carried out every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block
The battery 
 chargers will be used to charge the batteries for units 1, 2 & 3, 4 as 
 follows:
Units 1, 2 | 173 Cells, Nicd | 21 Cells, Nicd
I/P | 3x380 V, 50 HZ , 75KVA , 114A | 3x380V , 50 HZ, 60 kVA, 97 A
O/P | 220 V dc , 310 A dc | 29V dc , 1250A dc
Units 3,4 | 173 Cells, Nicd | 21 Cells, Nicd
I/P | 3x380 V, 50 HZ , 275KVA , 415A | 3x380V , 50HZ, 20.5KVA, 31A
O/P | 268 Vdc, 800A dc | 32.6 VDC, 400 Adc
The first draft is initiated by 
electrical maintenance manger eng. Mohammed Abdel Moneim, tested by eng. Yasser 
Abdo, accepted by eng. Sayed Farag: general director, revised by EDEPC 
inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El-Nagar& 
eng. Saad Basuony, approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latif 
Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control's general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman

 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
